body:
So I got a hold of some Red Devil Xanax (which were really expensive but really strong) that were 6mg Alp each, and my guy threw in a few flualprazolam bars for a really cheap price. I was told to be careful with both as they both pack a punch and oh boy they did.
T+0:00 - Took 1 red devil xanax at approx 6pm, waited half an hour and I started getting really drowsy. I became really social so I decided to call my close mate and she instantly asked what's wrong with me because I'm slurring my words, which I do not recall but hey I was the one on drugs not her so I trusted her judgement and hung up and spent the rest of my day alone chilling playing games.
T+24:00 - 24 hours later I decide it's time to take another xanax, but this time I tried the flualprazolam bars (which were apparently 2mg each). I took 1 and nothing. I took 2 and nothing, I took 3 and as soon as I took the 3rd one either the 1st or 2nd bar started hitting. Oh no I thought to myself.
T+36:00 - I woke up 12 hours later with no recollection of what has happened. I checked my stash and I luckily only took 3 of the flualprazolam bars.
T+48:00 - It was once again 6pm and as per usual that's when I take my dose of alprazolam. I took 1 red devil xanax and nothing, so I took another one and still felt nothing. Now I've taken 12mg alp altogether and I'm not feeling anything.
I ended up eating like 5 red devil xanax bars ONLY to feel a slight buzz. That's how I found out that tolerance to benzos builds up incredibly quickly, so I strongly suggest people take it low and slow and take breaks.
